text:
jia: quick follow-up on the cancel/ retry signal RFC — i'm worried we still don't have a clear client-visible contract for midstream cancels vs soft aborts. can we sync on what the gateway should expose?

sam: +1, this has been tripping up test infra. we need deterministic behavior for SDK teams.

anya: are we aiming for two things: (1) cancellable-but-resumable streams and (2) client-visible partial responses for long polls? those have different guarantees.

jia: exactly. my take: cancel from client should map to an opaque _intent_ header to upstreams, not an immediate hard abort unless the request is marked non-resumable. otherwise gateway should attempt soft-close and surface a `partial-response` trailer if available.

mike: can you sketch how the header looks? also how retries interact if upstream acknowledges partial output but finalization fails.

jia: rough sketch: `X-RW-Cancel-Intent: soft|hard|resume-point=<hex>` and `X-RW-Retry-Token: <id>` for idempotency/hedging. the retry token persists across soft-close hops.

sam: hmm i worry about header explosion. alternative: use `X-RW-Stream-Mode: resumable` + `X-RW-Stream-Token` for state. simpler parsing.

anya: +1 for `Stream-Mode`. important point: if upstream returns a partial chunk and later we retry, we must avoid double-delivery. that means the gateway needs a canonical checkpoint id from upstream to advance client-visible cursor.

mike: is that checkpoint always provided? many backends won't. what happens then?

jia: if no checkpoint, we treat resume as impossible and fallback to 'best-effort' idempotent retry semantics: either re-run or return error. that's why we need a `resumable` boolean in model onboarding metadata.

ops-bot: deploy bot: rollout v2 of gateway feature-flag `edge-soft-cancel` scheduled for midnight UTC. :rocket:

sam: ops-bot noted. that means we have both code and rollout gating. good.

anya: telemetry implications: we must tag traces with `rw.stream.mode` and `rw.retry.policy` + emit events when we convert a soft-close into a hard abort. otherwise debugging is impossible.

mike: regarding retries: propose model where gateway hedges only when `X-RW-Retry-Token` present and backend advertises `checkpoint-id`. otherwise gateway retries only on idempotent routes (safe). avoids side-effects.

jia: agreed. also need to define what we surface to SDKs: a `partial_response` boolean + `resume_token` (opaque) in the final trailers. example trailers: ```
partial-response: true
resume-token: "a1b2c3"
final-status: incomplete
```

sam: SDK folks want a stable shape. can we avoid changing trailer names later? tag as GA only after 2 weeks beta.

anya: action items i take: (1) update RFC appendix with header names & semantic table, (2) add SDK contract draft, (3) add trace spans and feature-flag tests.

mike: i'll add the server-side checklist: backend must advertise `supports_resume: true` in model manifest and return `checkpoint-id` at consistent flush points.

jia: one more thing — billing: partial responses should be billed proportionally to tokens emitted so far. we need accounting hooks when `partial-response` trailer emitted.

ops-bot: ci result: `edge_soft_cancel_tests` failed on one flaky test, linking: https://ci.internal/runs/98765

sam: will investigate flaky test. likely test assumes immediate hard abort.

anya: +1. i'll coordinate with SDK team on error enums: `INCOMPLETE`, `RESUMABLE` vs `NON_RESUMABLE`.

jia: cool. if no objections i'll fold these into the RFC appendix and ping for review by EOD. :thumbsup:
